title: BECE National Values Education: Social Studies - National Values Education - Purpose of Marriage
exam: BECE National Values Education: Social Studies
subject: National Values Education

questions.q: In the context of Social Studies, which of the following is the most accurate definition of marriage?
options: A temporary agreement between two friends to live together
A socially, culturally, and legally recognized union between a man and a woman to become husband and wife
An economic contract to merge two businesses together
A religious ceremony strictly meant for giving birth to children
questions.explain: **Marriage** is defined as the socially, culturally, and legally recognized union that legally binds a man and a woman as husband and wife.
questions.exam: BECE National Values Education: Social Studies
questions.subject: National Values Education

questions.q: The biological process of giving birth to children to ensure the continuation of the human race is recognized as which purpose of marriage?
questions.explain: **Procreation** is a primary purpose of marriage, meant to ensure the legitimate reproduction and continuation of human society.
questions.exam: BECE National Values Education: Social Studies
questions.subject: National Values Education

questions.q: Which of the following describes how marriage satisfies the 'social needs' of individuals?
options: By encouraging isolation from the rest of the community
By providing mutual companionship and removing loneliness
By competing with in-laws for political positions
By restricting the individuals from working outside the home
questions.explain: Marriage fulfills a fundamental human **social need for companionship**, partnership, and the avoidance of isolation and loneliness.
questions.exam: BECE National Values Education: Social Studies
questions.subject: National Values Education

questions.q: Society promotes marriage as the legitimate and morally acceptable avenue for achieving:
questions.explain: Across cultures and laws, marriage provides the recognized and morally acceptable framework for fulfilling desires for **sexual satisfaction**.
questions.exam: BECE National Values Education: Social Studies
questions.subject: National Values Education

questions.q: When a couple marries to pool their resources together, support one another's careers, and build wealth jointly, they are fulfilling which purpose of marriage?
questions.explain: A major objective of marriage is **satisfying economic needs** through mutual financial support, shared expenses, and wealth building as partners.
questions.exam: BECE National Values Education: Social Studies
questions.subject: National Values Education

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a recognized purpose of marriage according to the Social Studies syllabus?
questions.explain: The purposes of marriage include procreation, economic/social satisfaction, sexual satisfaction, and mutual love. **Exploitation** is inherently negative and not a purpose of marriage.
questions.exam: BECE National Values Education: Social Studies
questions.subject: National Values Education

questions.q: Through marriage, two individuals develop deep emotional attachments, understanding, and affection for each other. This directly refers to which purpose of marriage?
questions.explain: The emotional bond that is nurtured over time between husband and wife addresses the purpose of **growth in mutual love and affection**.
questions.exam: BECE National Values Education: Social Studies
questions.subject: National Values Education

questions.q: Because the family is built upon marriage, achieving stability in marriage ultimately satisfies which broader societal need?
options: Building a stable, disciplined, and functional society
questions.explain: Marriage provides the foundation for the family unit. When marriages fulfill their purpose, they yield well-socialized children, which satisfies the societal need for a **stable, disciplined, and functional society**.
questions.exam: BECE National Values Education: Social Studies
questions.subject: National Values Education
